en: Color-tinted historic postcard showing a ceremonial gathering around an obelisk-style fountain set on a multi-tiered pedestal with ornate lamps. People in formal dress stand on both sides, with flags bearing crescents and stars. A green 10-para Ottoman stamp is affixed in the upper-right corner. At the bottom, printed captions in French identify the location as Salonique, Turquie and the monument as Fontaine Hamidie, with additional handwritten script over the lower part.
